title: 起重吊装与吊索具
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/145_起重吊装与吊索具.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/145_起重吊装与吊索具/src.py

shots.scene: 欣欣戴安全帽站在吊车旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot wears a safety helmet and stands beside a small mobile crane outside a campus building, looking at the camera.
shots.narration: 第12章第八课：起重吊装与吊索具。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着悬在半空的箱子
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points up at a large crate hanging from the crane hook, raising one finger in warning.
shots.narration: 吊着的东西，随时可能掉下来。

shots.scene: 新实验楼外，吊车把大型仪器吊进三楼窗口
shots.prompt_en: Outside a new laboratory building, a mobile crane lifts a large instrument crate toward a third floor opening.
shots.narration: 新楼外，吊车正把大仪器吊上三楼。

shots.scene: 学生们围在吊物下方拍照
shots.prompt_en: Several students gather right under the hanging crate, holding up phones to take photos.
shots.narration: 几个学生围在下面拍照。

shots.scene: 吊带边缘起毛
shots.prompt_en: Close view: a frayed edge on a lifting sling wrapped around the crate. No text.
shots.narration: 吊带边上，已经磨起了毛。

shots.scene: 王老师拉起警戒，把学生请出去
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator sets up a barrier tape and waves the students away from under the load.
shots.narration: 王老师：快出来，吊物下不能站人！

shots.scene: 起重机司机和指挥出示操作证
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a crane operator and a signal person each holding a blank operator certificate card. No text.
shots.narration: 起重机械是特种设备，司机指挥要持证。

shots.scene: 起重机贴检验合格标志
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a mobile crane with a blank inspection passed tag on its cab, a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 起重设备要检验合格，才能使用。

shots.scene: 指挥人员用手势指挥
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: one signal person in a vest giving a hand signal to the crane operator. No text.
shots.narration: 现场一人统一指挥。

shots.scene: 学生操作起重设备打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a student reaching for a crane control or a hoist pendant, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 无证不能操作，学生更不能上手。

shots.scene: 带电线路上方、接近满载、两台吊车抬吊
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, a load swinging near overhead power lines, a load gauge near full, and two cranes lifting one load. No text.
shots.narration: 靠近电线、接近满载、多机抬吊，都属关键吊装。

shots.scene: 吊装方案和审批章
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a blank lifting plan with a load chart icon receiving an approval stamp. No text.
shots.narration: 关键吊装，先编方案、按规定审批。

shots.scene: 吊装前交底
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a supervisor briefing the crane operator, the signal person and the riggers beside the load. No text.
shots.narration: 吊前交底，人人清楚分工。

shots.scene: 吊具标牌上的最大载荷
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a lifting sling with a blank label and a weight icon showing the maximum allowed load. No text.
shots.narration: 安全工作载荷：允许吊的最大重量。

shots.scene: 超载吊带断裂打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an overloaded sling snapping under a heavy block, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 超过它，吊具就可能断。坚决不吊。

shots.scene: 吊带夹角越大，受力越大
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two sling legs at a narrow angle and at a wide angle, the wide one with bigger force arrows. No text.
shots.narration: 吊挂方式和夹角，也会影响能吊多重。

shots.scene: 先知道吊物多重
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a crate with a question mark weight, then a weight label checked on its packing list. No text.
shots.narration: 起吊前，先弄清吊物多重。

shots.scene: 一排不同颜色的吊装带
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a row of flat lifting slings in purple, green, yellow, gray, red, brown, blue and orange. No text.
shots.narration: 吊装带常用颜色区分起吊能力。

shots.scene: 颜色只是参考，标准书打勾
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a colored sling with a question mark beside a national standard book with a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 颜色只是参考，以标签为准。

shots.scene: 【实拍】翻看吊装带上的标签（手部特写）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: hands turning over the sewn on label of a flat lifting sling to read it, the writing blurred.
shots.narration: 最可靠的，是看标签上的标注。

shots.scene: 标签没了或看不清打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a sling with a torn off label and a faded label, both crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 标签没了、看不清，就不能用。

shots.scene: 【实拍】双手逐段翻看吊装带两面（手部特写）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: hands running along a flat lifting sling section by section, turning it to check both faces.
shots.narration: 吊带每次用前，都要先检查。

shots.scene: 割伤、磨损、烧伤、化学腐蚀四种损伤
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: four sling sections showing a cut, worn fibers, a burn mark and a chemical stain. No text.
shots.narration: 割伤、磨损、烧伤、腐蚀，立即停用。

shots.scene: 绕过锐边加护套
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a sling passing over the sharp edge of a steel frame with a protective sleeve in between. No text.
shots.narration: 绕过锐边，要加护套。

shots.scene: 打结、拧绞的吊带打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a knotted sling and a twisted sling, both crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不打结、不拧绞，不拿吊带接长。

shots.scene: D形和弓形卸扣
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a D shaped shackle and a bow shaped shackle side by side. No text.
shots.narration: 卸扣常见两种：D形和弓形。

shots.scene: 卸扣的弓身、耳部、销轴
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a shackle with its body, its two ears and its pin highlighted. No text.
shots.narration: 卸扣由弓身、耳部、销轴组成。

shots.scene: 【实拍】查看卸扣上的刻印标记并拧紧销轴（手部特写）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: hands checking the stamped markings on a shackle body and screwing its pin fully home.
shots.narration: 看清载荷标记，销轴拧到位。

shots.scene: 变形、裂纹、标记不清的打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a bent shackle, a cracked one and one with worn off markings, all crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 变形、裂纹、标记不清，不能用。

shots.scene: 吊钩带防脱钩装置
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a crane hook with a working safety latch, and a hook with a broken latch crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 吊钩要有防脱钩装置，开口不变形。

shots.scene: 汽车吊支腿完全伸出，垫上垫板
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a mobile crane with its outriggers fully extended on solid pads on firm ground. No text.
shots.narration: 支腿让起重机稳住，不会翻倒。

shots.scene: 支腿不是加高增力
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an outrigger with a crossed out arrow pointing up for extra height and a tick for stability. No text.
shots.narration: 支腿不是用来加高、加力的。

shots.scene: 软地、沟边支腿下陷打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a crane outrigger sinking into soft soil near a trench edge, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 软地、沟边，不能随便支吊车。

shots.scene: 大风中吊物摆动
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a load swinging wide on a crane hook in strong wind, wind lines blowing. No text.
shots.narration: 风会让吊物晃动、失稳。

shots.scene: 没超载也停
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a load gauge within its limit but a strong wind icon, with a stop sign. No text.
shots.narration: 没超载，风大也不能吊。

shots.scene: 风速仪和说明书
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an anemometer beside a blank crane manual, a stop hand when the wind is too strong. No text.
shots.narration: 风速限值，按说明书和规程。

shots.scene: 风大时吊篮载人打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a crane basket carrying a worker in strong wind, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 风大更不能用吊篮载人。

shots.scene: 雷雨、大雾也停止
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: lightning, heavy rain and fog icons beside a crane with a stop sign. No text.
shots.narration: 雷雨、大雾、看不清，也要停吊。

shots.scene: 吊装区拉警戒，挂警示
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a lifting area surrounded by barriers and warning signs, a guard at the entrance. No text.
shots.narration: 吊装区域拉警戒，无关人员不进。

shots.scene: 吊物下站人打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person standing under a hanging load, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 吊物下面，绝不站人、不穿行。

shots.scene: 阿杰绕开吊装区
shots.prompt_en: The young male student walks around the barrier of the lifting area on a detour path.
shots.narration: 多走几步，绕开走。

shots.scene: 用牵引绳控制吊物，不用手推
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a rigger guiding a hanging load with a tag line from a distance, a hand pushing the load crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 用牵引绳稳住吊物，手不扶吊物。

shots.scene: 大型仪器进楼：专业单位按方案吊装
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a professional rigging team with a lifting plan moving a large instrument crate into a laboratory building. No text.
shots.narration: 大型仪器进楼，请有资质的单位按方案吊装。

shots.scene: 实验室内用专用搬运工具移动设备
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: riggers moving a heavy instrument on rollers and a hydraulic pallet jack inside a lab corridor. No text.
shots.narration: 室内移动重设备，由专业人员用工具搬。

shots.scene: 检查楼板承重和通道
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the facility engineer checking floor load and door width along the route before moving equipment. No text.
shots.narration: 先查楼板承重、通道和电梯。

shots.scene: 学生徒手搬重设备打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two students trying to lift a heavy instrument by hand, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 学生不徒手搬大型设备。

shots.scene: 操作证和方案
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two icons, a blank operator certificate card and a blank lifting plan. No text.
shots.narration: 持证操作，关键吊装有方案。

shots.scene: 标签和检查
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two icons, a sling label and a magnifier over a shackle. No text.
shots.narration: 不超载，用前查吊带和卸扣。

shots.scene: 风大停、吊物下不站人
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two icons, a strong wind stop sign and a person under a load crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 风大停吊，吊物下面不站人。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在施工围挡前挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a campus construction fence and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：校园施工与承包商安全。
